name: clover-security
description: Protect your coding agent experience. Clover catches missing security requirements before code is written — automatic STRIDE-style threat modeling on every plan, zero ceremony, zero interruption.

plugins.name: clover
plugins.description: Ship secure code at agent speed. Clover silently reviews every plan, surfaces missing security requirements, and folds them into the work before a single line is written — no questions, no detours.

plugins.name: clover-for-security-teams
plugins.description: Ask Clover about your application's security posture from inside your coding agent. Run security reviews, surface threats and required controls, and design securely, answered in natural language.

plugins.name: clover-for-developers
plugins.description: Clover's security assistant for developers. Kick off a security/design review on the change you are working on, get security feedback on a design review (by its link), and read back the reviews you have access to — answered in natural language.
